purpose: DIAGNOSTIC proxies for reward shaping / evaluation. Not measured club or ball data.

units.time: seconds in real video time (v2 clips); slow-mo clips in VIDEO seconds with *_real_est
units.axes: tgt = toward target (address hip line), up = vertical, oth = lateral (sign arbitrary)

field_definitions.hand_tgt_at_*: mid-wrist position along the target axis relative to mid-hip / torso (view-dependent: DTL uses monocular depth)
field_definitions.hand_forward_vs_address_at_impact: hand_tgt(impact) - hand_tgt(address); + = hands ahead of address, toward target. HAND-FORWARD PROXY (lag/lean), NOT shaft lean
field_definitions.lead_arm_lean_*_deg: angle of lead-shoulder->lead-wrist line from vertical in the (tgt, up) plane; + = wrist toward target. Arm-line proxy, not shaft
field_definitions.low_point_t_minus_impact_s: time of minimum mid-wrist height in [top, impact+0.20s] minus impact event (+ = after impact)
field_definitions.hand_path: 21-sample path takeaway(0)->impact(1) in (tgt, up, oth), relative to address hand position

recommended_use.reward_ready_note: Use as soft bands (IQR / bootstrap CI), vertical + timing only; Mason's impact event looks early vs the hand low point (see docs), so prefer the low-point-relative form over absolute hand height at the event.
recommended_use.diagnostic_only_note: Forward/lean proxies are low confidence: only 2-3 clips pass the view-axis agreement test and only 3 have an address window; the DTL depth axis is unreliable.

unavailable.reason: No club or ball data exists in any Mason file. Shaft lean can only be proxied by hand-forward / lead-arm-line lean. Launch angle needs a launch monitor or club tracking; it is NOT derived here.

selection.mason_v2: recommended, commercial_ok, not partial, handedness left, native (or un-mirrored flipped edit) - same as data/mason_target_features.py
selection.mason_v3_slowmo: recommended native-left slow-motion clips; reported per-swing, excluded from the aggregate

weights.weight_forward: quality_score * coverage * view_weight(face_on 1, oblique 0.6, DTL 0.4) * 1/(1+axis_std/20deg) * view_axis_agreement (inferred target axis vs labelled view; 1 = agrees, 0 = >=45 deg off), 0 if address window <4 frames; normalised
weights.note: quality_score is a ranking heuristic, not accuracy

cmu_subject64.frame: TRUE 3-D (not view-limited); same definitions: tgt = address hip line, up = world Y
caveats: Slow recreational volunteer (tempo ~1.7), right-handed; features are lead/trail-defined so handedness-invariant. Wrist midpoint, no club.

synthetic.caveat: Generator is a planar joint-angle model with an analytic club-head; stores no hand positions. Low point shown is CLUB-HEAD vertical minimum in [top, impact+0.2s] and is a by-construction artefact (the model has no ball/ground contact), only a sanity reference.

uncertainty.time_resolution: stored landmarks are ~30 unique fps (60 Hz upsampled): low-point / impact timing +-~0.05 s (1 source frame on the impact event + 1 sample); events are detector heuristics
uncertainty.geometry: monocular MediaPipe world landmarks: depth axis (z) is model-prior-driven. Heights are the most reliable; target-axis (forward) quantities are weakest in down-the-line clips
uncertainty.bootstrap: weighted_median_ci90_bootstrap = 5-95% of 500 resamples (seed 0), describes sampling spread only, not bias

caveats: Single 2D/monocular view per clip; every number is view-dependent (mostly DTL, some oblique, few face-on).
Hand = wrist midpoint, not grip; there is no club. Shaft lean unavailable; only hand-forward / arm-line lean proxies.
Low point is of the HANDS, not the club head; it is not a divot/low-point-of-arc measurement.
Launch angle is not derived and must not be inferred from these numbers; it requires a launch monitor or club tracking.
Impact/top/takeaway events are detector heuristics at ~30 fps; per-swing noise is large; n is small.
Mason clips may be of mixed camera zoom/tilt; world-landmark vertical assumes an upright camera.
CMU is a slow recreational volunteer (true 3-D, no club); synthetic has no hand data.
